questions.prompt: Which taught meaning of 光 fits this context?
questions.context: The speaker describes the presence of illumination in this place.

choices.label: The speaker does nothing except one activity.
choices.feedback: As a noun, 光 means light.

choices.label: There is light here.
choices.feedback: As a noun, 光 means light.

choices.label: An action has used up everything.
choices.feedback: As a noun, 光 means light.

questions.prompt: Which taught meaning of 光 fits this context?
questions.context: The speaker criticizes someone for talking without acting.

choices.label: He acts without speaking.
choices.feedback: Before a predicate, 光 means only or merely, often criticizing the absence of another needed activity.

choices.label: His words give off light.
choices.feedback: Before a predicate, 光 means only or merely, often criticizing the absence of another needed activity.

choices.label: He only talks and does not act.
choices.feedback: Before a predicate, 光 means only or merely, often criticizing the absence of another needed activity.

questions.label: Recognize the taught lexical use
questions.prompt: Which taught meaning of 光 fits this context?
questions.context: The person ate the rice and none remains.

choices.label: He did not eat any rice.
choices.feedback: After a verb of consuming or using, 光 expresses a complete result with none left. Here 吃 + 光 describes eating all the rice.

choices.label: He ate all the rice.
choices.feedback: After a verb of consuming or using, 光 expresses a complete result with none left. Here 吃 + 光 describes eating all the rice.

choices.label: He ate only a little of the rice.
choices.feedback: After a verb of consuming or using, 光 expresses a complete result with none left. Here 吃 + 光 describes eating all the rice.
